scope: Internal authoring rig for baking finished whole-character illustrated South walk cels. This contract does not authorize image calls, runtime puppet output, animation keys, in-betweens, or integration.

art_calls.opening_condition: Parent reviews this contract and issues a separate finite work order. Generate one original component per authorized call; stop on missing or materially wrong anatomy.

primary_south_reference.role: Sealed South canonical full-body appearance and neutral rest-shape authority. It is still a static identity candidate, not final art approval.

camera.source_fringe_warning: The sealed identity review retains a thin colored edge-fringe candidate warning; do not clean, crop, or normalize it as part authoring.

side_ownership.actor_left: Near side in the front-facing South reference; appears on viewer-right. The asymmetric sash/knot remains on actor LEFT and viewer-right.
side_ownership.actor_right: Far side in the front-facing South reference; appears on viewer-left.
side_ownership.mirroring: Forbidden. Preserve the locked face, costume asymmetry, palette, lighting, and view.

component_policy.final_visual_method: Each authored pose is rendered and baked as a complete illustrated full-character PNG cel. Runtime consumes finished frames, never independently rotating component sprites.
component_policy.texture_handling: Retain each original RGBA component immutably with byte and decoded-RGBA hashes. No crop, alpha cleanup, tracing, repaint, per-frame fit, or anisotropic scaling.
component_policy.rest_pose: Use the sealed South neutral reference. Limbs are authored naturally unbent; do not pre-bend elbows or knees.
component_policy.calibration: For each original component, record one immutable measured uniform raw-to-rest scale/rotation/translation. Model fixed-camera 3D depth foreshortening separately; it must not become per-frame bbox fitting or variable bone length. Exact component calibration is pending originals.
component_policy.landmarks: All natural landmarks remain PENDING actual original-part inspection. Record source-pixel coordinates, measurement method, and uncertainty only after each original exists. Hidden pivots must be marked as authored hypotheses, never measurements.
component_policy.projection: Keep the 2:1 dimetric camera fixed. Bone lengths are constant in model space; screen endpoint lengths may foreshorten by camera-plane projection. No per-frame rescaling.

parts.ownership: Hat, head, neck, full central torso/tunic, sash and its asymmetric knot/tail, pelvis, and tunic hem in one rigid illustrated core.
parts.rest_axis: Neutral South; head over torso and pelvis. No independent head, sash, or torso articulation in this minimal topology.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Paint sufficient hidden sleeve and thigh overlap beneath the core at all four attachment regions. Core masks close proximal seams. Preserve sash and hem silhouette; no holes at shoulders or hips.
parts.landmarks: Shoulder-cap and hip-under-hem locations are pending direct inspection of the original component and sealed South source; no coordinates supplied.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT/far upper arm and sleeve, shoulder cap through elbow overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Shoulder to elbow in the natural neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Proximal cap extends beneath core mask; distal end overlaps actor RIGHT lower arm at elbow. Far-side arm normally draws behind core except authored visible silhouette; permit pose-specific ordering where needed.
parts.landmarks: Shoulder, elbow, and usable overlap bounds pending.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT/far forearm, cuff, wrist, and hand integrated into one illustrated component.
parts.rest_axis: Elbow to wrist/hand in neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap the upper-arm art at elbow and preserve a wrist semantic joint for counter-swing without separating the hand texture. No disembodied hand gap.
parts.landmarks: Elbow, wrist, hand center, and grip/attachment point if visible are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT/near upper arm and sleeve, shoulder cap through elbow overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Shoulder to elbow in the natural neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Proximal cap extends beneath core mask; distal end overlaps actor LEFT lower arm at elbow. Near-side arm may overlay the core at the visible shoulder seam, without painting over or relocating the asymmetric sash knot/tail.
parts.landmarks: Shoulder, elbow, and usable overlap bounds pending.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT/near forearm, cuff, wrist, and hand integrated into one illustrated component.
parts.rest_axis: Elbow to wrist/hand in neutral South view; exact axis and endpoints pending measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap the upper-arm art at elbow and preserve a wrist semantic joint for counter-swing with the hand attached. Protect actor-LEFT sash silhouette and avoid hand/body intersections in the baked pose.
parts.landmarks: Elbow, wrist, and hand center are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT/far upper leg and trouser thigh from hidden hip overlap to knee overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Hip to knee in neutral South view; exact axis/endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Top extends beneath the core hem mask. Distal end overlaps the corresponding lower leg at the knee. Normally behind actor LEFT where legs cross, subject to explicit per-pose depth ordering.
parts.landmarks: Hidden hip is an authored hypothesis; visible thigh/knee bounds and uncertainty are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor RIGHT/far lower leg, shin wraps, ankle, foot, and sandal integrated as one illustrated texture.
parts.rest_axis: Knee to ankle in neutral South view. Include a semantic ankle/foot-plane sub-joint or authored shin/foot mesh regions so the sandal sole can hold contact while the shin rotates; exact boundary is pending actual art inspection.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap upper leg at knee. Preserve heel, toe, and sole contact plane as a single rigid foot region during stance. Use controlled local deformation only at the authored mesh boundary; reject any setup that bends the sandal/sole or stretches bone lengths to force contact.
parts.landmarks: Knee, ankle, heel, toe, sole plane, and mesh boundary all pending actual original inspection.
parts.mesh_contract: The original component author must provide separate shin and foot/sandal mesh polygons with a shared ankle seam, plus independently inspected natural ankle, heel, toe, and sole-plane landmarks. The foot plane may remain planted while the shin rotates. If polygons or landmarks are absent or ambiguous, this part remains unresolved and the baker must refuse it; do not infer coordinates or rotate the entire texture as one rigid segment.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT/near upper leg and trouser thigh from hidden hip overlap to knee overlap.
parts.rest_axis: Hip to knee in neutral South view; exact axis/endpoints pending original-part measurement.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Top extends beneath the core hem mask, while visible near-side thigh may overlay the far thigh. Distal end overlaps actor LEFT lower leg at the knee; order may change per pose at crossings.
parts.landmarks: Hidden hip is an authored hypothesis; visible thigh/knee bounds and uncertainty are pending.

parts.ownership: Actor LEFT/near lower leg, shin wraps, ankle, foot, and sandal integrated as one illustrated texture.
parts.rest_axis: Knee to ankle in neutral South view. Include a semantic ankle/foot-plane sub-joint or authored shin/foot mesh regions so the sandal sole can hold contact while the shin rotates; exact boundary is pending actual art inspection.
parts.overlap_and_depth: Overlap upper leg at knee. Preserve heel, toe, and sole contact plane as a single rigid foot region during stance. Permit actor LEFT to be the F0/F1/F2/F3 support track, then transfer support to actor RIGHT at F4; this contract does not authorize key creation.
parts.landmarks: Knee, ankle, heel, toe, sole plane, and mesh boundary all pending actual original inspection.
parts.mesh_contract: The original component author must provide separate shin and foot/sandal mesh polygons with a shared ankle seam, plus independently inspected natural ankle, heel, toe, and sole-plane landmarks. The foot plane may remain planted while the shin rotates. If polygons or landmarks are absent or ambiguous, this part remains unresolved and the baker must refuse it; do not infer coordinates or rotate the entire texture as one rigid segment.

pose_contract_reference.current_state: These are design constraints only. Existing F0 is a parent-selected candidate; F2 attempts are held. This preparation contract creates no selected rig pose, finished cel, or cycle approval.
